prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1463; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal. Claimant identified as driver of other vehicle. Claimant reports wrist fracture. Claimant is represented by counsel; all contact to go through attorney's office. Initial liability review opened.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Confirmed representation letter on file. Requested police report, scene photos, and medical authorization forms. Attorney indicated claimant is in ongoing treatment for wrist fracture and will provide records once care is stabilized.

Entry 3: Reviewed police report. Officer notes both drivers gave conflicting accounts of signal phase. Witness statement obtained from pedestrian at corner. Preliminary fault assessment pending. Vehicle damage consistent with side impact to driver's side of claimant vehicle.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's attorney. Diagnosis confirmed as fracture of wrist with orthopedic follow-up scheduled. Recovery timeline estimated at several weeks with possible therapy. Bodily injury claim evaluation opened. Reserve reviewed against current file information.

Entry 5: Attorney's office sent demand package requesting settlement consideration. Package under review by claims supervisor. Liability position under evaluation pending final review of witness statement and signal timing data. Response to attorney to follow after internal review is complete.
